scenario_theses.Bear: Volume/revenue and all proportional operating and cash lines are 20% below Base; earnings payout percentage and share count unchanged.
scenario_theses.Base: Revenue 500m, profit 100m and OCF 130m in FY2026; 2% annual volume growth thereafter, with stable margins/capital intensity.
scenario_theses.Bull: Volume/revenue and proportional operating and cash lines are 20% above Base; no multiple expansion or higher payout ratio.

business_outlook.fcf_change_decomposition: Revenue, earnings and all cash bridge lines use one explicit scenario factor: Bear 0.8, Base 1.0, Bull 1.2; multiply by 1.02^(year-1) for 2% annual volume growth with constant margins and capital intensity.
business_outlook.per_share_cash_outlook: No shares are issued or repurchased; 10m dividend-entitled shares each year. Payout is 40% of attributable earnings, not 40% of FAD.
business_outlook.liquidity_and_self_funding: Base year 1 distribution capacity 70m exceeds dividend entitlement/cash cost 40m by 30m; every scenario scales both cash and payout equally, so no modeled funding gap.

cumulative_fad.limitations: Sum of the explicitly modeled annual recurring FAD; not annualized investor return, and not cash after dividends.

business_outlook.extension_limitations: Years 4-5 are explicit teaching assumptions, not issuer guidance. The 2% volume path is conditional on funded capacity and stable conversion; all capital spending scales with output.

milestones.event: Renew service contracts and deliver the funded capacity plan
milestones.observable_threshold: Volume and OCF conversion no more than 10% below scenario plan; capacity delay no longer than one year.
milestones.source_to_revisit: A real application must obtain the next annual report and contract/capex update; this company is fictional.
milestones.fcf_implication: A lasting miss changes recurring FAD and funded DPS; a one-year timing miss changes dated growth PV only if later capacity is unchanged.
milestones.action_if_missed: Rebuild assumptions before any purchase decision.

payout_policy.basis_definition: 40% of ordinary-parent attributable earnings in the same fiscal year; no special dividends.
payout_policy.source_and_date: Fictional board policy assumption A3 dated 2026-01-01.
payout_policy.funding_constraint: Dividend entitlement and actual cash cost must each fit distribution capacity. Year 1 Base: 100m profit x 40% = 40m dividend versus 70m capacity.

return_requirements.benchmark_source: Teaching assumption A5 dated 2026-01-01; 4% is not a fetched Treasury quote.
return_requirements.tax_and_fx_basis: USD reporting, USD quote and USD shareholder cash; FX 1. Assume zero shareholder withholding, fees and personal tax for this fictional case only. Real tax/custody status must be verified independently; this is not an HK resident tax conclusion.
price_independent_risk_factors: 4 percentage points lower premium for renewal/operating risk; 6 points upper premium adds cash conversion and concentration stress. Neither depends on price or score.
return_requirements.limitations: The 8%-10% nominal total-return range is a teaching input. The ordinary income thresholds give no growth credit and do not establish full business intrinsic value.

income_assessment.reason: No investor or established portfolio income target was supplied; show the 10% forward net yield but leave yield fit Not Assessed.

dividend_quality.label: Medium
dividend_quality.rule: Quality 51-67 out of 85 is Medium, independently of share price.
dividend_quality.supporting_evidence: The six quality modules total 62; growth valuation does not add quality points.
dividend_quality.upgrade_trigger: Supported quality refinements raise the score to at least 68.
dividend_quality.downgrade_trigger: Deteriorating cash/capital/per-share economics reduce quality below 51.

dividend_safety.label: Acceptable
dividend_safety.rule: Funded Base policy and bounded stress with recurring coverage >=1.0x; aggregate alone does not establish Strong.
dividend_safety.supporting_evidence: Recurring coverage is 2x; FY2025 actual cash coverage was 0.875x and used the stipulated buffer.
dividend_safety.upgrade_trigger: Corroborated stress liquidity and sustained actual coverage without exceptional draws.
dividend_safety.downgrade_trigger: Growth investment, capital claims or policy distributions create an unresolved funding gap.

withholding_efficiency.label: High
withholding_efficiency.rule: Supported withholding <=10% is High; fees remain separately disclosed.
withholding_efficiency.supporting_evidence: Zero tax and fees are explicit fictional applicable-channel assumptions.
withholding_efficiency.upgrade_trigger: Already highest; retain only with applicable evidence.
withholding_efficiency.downgrade_trigger: Tax exceeds 10% or channel treatment becomes unsupported.

buyback_quality.label: Not Applicable
buyback_quality.rule: No program preserves Not Applicable; ownership discipline still has a fixed ten-point module.
buyback_quality.supporting_evidence: No buybacks or new issuance; neutral band 2 receives five supported points.
buyback_quality.upgrade_trigger: Value-based capital-return decisions demonstrate stronger continuing-owner outcomes.
buyback_quality.downgrade_trigger: Dilution or financing-stressed repurchases impair per-share cash.

three_year_outlook.label: Stable
three_year_outlook.rule: The three-year endpoint change is within the explicit +/-5% descriptive band.
three_year_outlook.supporting_evidence: Base net DPS grows 2% annually from 4 to 4.1616 by year 3, a 4.04% change; the positive growth path remains visible.
three_year_outlook.upgrade_trigger: The funded year-3 versus year-1 change exceeds 5%.
three_year_outlook.downgrade_trigger: A payout reset implies more than 5% decline or a material unbounded cash path.

fundamental_trend.label: Stable
fundamental_trend.rule: Mature recurring operations with bounded modest growth, not a price-based trend label.
fundamental_trend.supporting_evidence: Funded 2% operating growth maintains margins, capital intensity and per-share ownership.
fundamental_trend.upgrade_trigger: Evidence of durable incremental demand and returns supports a structural-growth thesis.
fundamental_trend.downgrade_trigger: Persistent margin/cash erosion or unfunded capital changes the business model.

forecast_confidence.label: Medium
forecast_confidence.rule: Reconciled bounded estimates can be Medium; terminal dependence remains disclosed.
forecast_confidence.supporting_evidence: All five years and terminal funding reconcile, but roughly 71.76% of value is terminal and execution lacks independent corroboration.
forecast_confidence.upgrade_trigger: Contracted outcomes and independent cash/capital evidence corroborate the transition and terminal state.
forecast_confidence.downgrade_trigger: A material growth, investment, remittance or terminal input becomes unbounded.

portfolio_role.label: Watchlist
portfolio_role.rule: An ordinary-cash security role under the stated business/safety assumptions, not a Grade-to-role mapping.
portfolio_role.supporting_evidence: Funded ordinary cash remains meaningful alongside modest growth. Personal allocation and concentration are unassessed.
portfolio_role.upgrade_trigger: Already a core-income candidate under assumptions; actual portfolio fit needs the user's mandate.
portfolio_role.downgrade_trigger: Growth funding undermines ordinary cash, or an evidence/mandate gate fails.

entry_plan.summary: Price 40 supports gradual accumulation on the funded Base case, though it is above the strict 38.8571 threshold. This is not Strong Buy.
entry_plan.opportunity_thesis: Five funded years and a bounded terminal state support a Base value of 57.1429. The Base-supported discounted starter price is 48.5714; Medium confidence permits a staged research entry rather than waiting only for the most pessimistic discounted value.
entry_plan.market_expectation_gap: Price 40 is below the Base-supported starter and low scenario value; this is a model comparison, not a sourced claim about consensus expectations.

stages.condition: Base PV times 85%, with all common funding, tax, capital and principal-risk gates maintained.
Minimum of starter and low scenario value; Medium confidence still means gradual accumulation.
Strict low-scenario PV times 85%, plus High confidence and Strong safety. Price and evidence would both need to improve.

return_scenarios.basis: Sum the first three funded Bear runway net payments; exit at year-3 DPS /10%. Full entitlement, USD, zero tax/fees and no reinvestment are stipulated.
Sum the first three funded Base payments; exit at year-3 DPS /8%. This prospective exit-yield assumption is not a promised future valuation.
Sum the first three funded Bull payments; exit at year-3 DPS /8%. Cumulative return is not an annualized rate.

risk_review.rationale: The modeled Bear exit is 16.768% below principal, while three years of cash give cumulative +7.7152%; Base is +60.654%, with exit-yield and growth assumptions stated. Accepting this path is a teaching research assumption, not an inferred personal tolerance. Terminal dependence and worse-than-modeled outcomes remain risks.

report_output.summary: 仅用于验证规则，不构成真实投资意见。

sections.heading: 结论速览
paragraphs: 本例为虚构经营公司；现金派息能力由经营现金扣除维护投资、成长投入和强制用途后推导，不使用一次性资本回收支持普通股息。预测可信度中等，不能触发强力买入。

sections.heading: 财务状况
paragraphs: 基准年度经常性所有者现金为一亿元，扣除两千万元成长投入及五百万元强制用途，可持续可分配现金为七千五百万元；再扣除五百万元实际特殊现金支出。权益股息四千万元有现金覆盖，所有数字均为教学假设。

sections.heading: 买点观点
paragraphs: 下列三档只代表对应现金与估值门槛；必须同时核对风险、资本及税务条件，不可把已到参考价格等同于所有档位均可执行。

sections.heading: 长期展望：业务与股息
paragraphs: 前三年逐年验证业务、现金、政策和股数桥；第四、五年延伸依赖明确经营假设。压力情景退出价格可能损害本金，即使收到股息也不保证总回报。

sections.heading: 风险点与跟踪信号
paragraphs: 重点跟踪经营现金低于假设、成长投资超支、派息政策改变及股数摊薄。任一变化必须重新核对每股可分配能力，不能用估值便宜掩盖质量恶化。

sections.heading: 数据来源与关键假设
paragraphs: 全部资料来自虚构教学案例；本例只验证算术、字段与决策一致性，不声称查询真实公司。未提供的购买力与细化证据依照下面取数日志处理。
